item.title: Arabic–English wedding website with a real right-to-left layout
item.description: A bilingual Arabic–English wedding website where the layout truly mirrors: navigation, RSVP, timeline and gallery all run right to left in Arabic. Add the katb al-kitab and the reception as separate events, collect RSVPs in both languages in one list, and keep Arabic guest names intact. Add French as a third language if you need it.
